comment: Class consisted of straight power points. Every single day. It was tough to stay engaged. The tests were tough and the averages were usually low. Would not take this class again.

material is interesting, however there are random pop quizzes that most people do poorly on and rubrics are posted after written assignments, lab is really fun - mostly outside, tests are based on class material and  pretty easy

I'm really interested in ecology but the class is very boring. Only uses powerpoint slides that are completely based on the text, but expects you to read the textbook and come to class. She does a poor job answering questions and making the content meaningful. The first exam average was a 74. She has a lot to learn as a first year teacher.
